3 · Cross-sections

The voxels from above at one level, with a west–east section above and a south–north section to the right, both through the column under the red dot. Drag the red dot in the plan to move the sections, and drag in either section to change the plan's level. The CPTs are dots in the plan. In the sections, each column they cross shows the median qc of its CPTs, in a band from their 10th to their 90th percentile. Hover over a CPT in the plan for its own qc, and over a voxel for its domain, stratigraphic unit and lithology class.
